- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (high sentiment > 0.3) — reduce forecast peak by 5–10%.
- Underestimate prices in bearish sentiment (sentiment < 0.2) — add 3–5% to forecast to compensate for mean reversion bias.
- Avoid overreacting to recent spikes — cap forecast increases after a 3-day +0.2 sentiment surge.
- If sentiment is trending upward but price is flat or declining, reduce forecast slope to avoid overshoot.
- For 30-day horizon, model tends to overpredict late-period prices — adjust final 5–7 days downward by 2–4% if sentiment is neutral or cooling.
- If sentiment is high but price history shows mean reversion, apply a 3–5% downward correction to avoid overbought bias.
